mapper.select: SELECT id, username, phone, password_hash AS passwordHash, status, role FROM users WHERE username = #{account} OR phone = #{account} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, phone, password_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash})
INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_id, nickname, avatar_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nickname}, #{avatar})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, p.nickname, p.avatar_url AS avatar, p.signature, u.phone, u.role FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.status = 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS nickname, p.avatar_url AS avatar, p.signature, p.visit_count AS visits, u.role FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.status = 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS nickname, p.avatar_url AS avatar, p.signature, u.phone, p.email, p.gender, p.birthday, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.role, p.visit_count AS visits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = u.id) AS favorites FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.status = 1

SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, t.tag_type AS tagType, ROUND(SUM(up.weight), 2) AS weight, COUNT(*) AS sourceCount, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT(up.source, ':', ROUND(up.weight, 2)) ORDER BY up.weight DESC, up.source ASC SEPARATOR ',' ) AS sourceSummary, MAX(up.updated_at) AS updatedAt FROM user_preferences up JOIN tags t ON t.id = up.tag_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.tag_type ORDER BY weight DESC, updatedAt DESC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT up.source, ROUND(SUM(up.weight), 2) AS weight, COUNT(*) AS count, MAX(up.updated_at) AS updatedAt FROM user_preferences up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY up.source ORDER BY weight DESC, updatedAt DESC

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(up.weight), 2), 0) AS totalWeight, COUNT(DISTINCT up.tag_id) AS tagCount, COUNT(*) AS signalCount, MAX(up.updated_at) AS lastUpdatedAt FROM user_preferences up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
